title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
Title: Staff Platform Engineer

Business Unit: Process Manufacturing

Location: Brazil, remote

About CAI

CAI is a leading provider of digital work execution platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity in industrial environments. CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.


In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

Come Join the CAI Team

At CAI, we pride ourselves on fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that working together across diverse teams not only drives innovation but also builds a supportive environment where everyone's contributions are valued. Our commitment to continuous learning and development is central to our ethos; we invest in career development and mentorship opportunities to help our employees thrive and expand their skill sets. With a clear focus on personal and professional growth, we offer a dynamic career path that encourages ambition and rewards dedication, ensuring that each team member has the opportunity to reach their full potential and advance within the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the execution of architecture, development, implementation and quality practices in support of delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform
  • Implementation of cloud platform, operational and architectural patterns and practices to enable key features and drive new feature development
  • Participate in the selection of technology enablers to deliver performant, reliable and cost-optimized solutions
  • Design, build, and maintain cloud platform capabilities, aligned with DevOps and operational practices to rapidly and safely deploy new features to our platform
  • Collaborate with Product, Professional Services, and other stakeholders to develop new cloud-platform features and products
  • Create technical documentation for accessing, integrating, and using Parsable platform capabilities
  • Act as a senior technical team member in the delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform; gain and consistently maintain deep knowledge of our cloud platform and implementation technologies
  • Serve as a senior technical team member and subject matter expert within the platform engineering team and the larger engineering organization
  • Improve and build observability, uptime, and readiness metrics to detect problems and maintain our SLAs with our customers
  • Implement DevSecOps tooling, processes and procedures to promote rapid iteration and reliable delivery of new and updated features
  • Deliver quality work in an agile delivery model within a team environment
  • Share your work and data engineering best practices across the organization

Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years experience delivering customer-facing platforms at scale
  • 5+ years experience architecting, building and releasing production-grade within a SaaS environment
  • 5+ years experience developing backend services capabilities leveraging Go and/or Node (Typescript)
  • Demonstrated, hands-on mastery of the AWS suite of tools including Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, EventBridge, ECS, S3, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, and AuroraDB
  • Deep experience building product capabilities in a microservices architecture
  • Ability to assert and defend opinions on the merits of differing solutions
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Additional Requirements

  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience working in a global organization

By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.


In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

Come Join the CAI Team

At CAI, we pride ourselves on fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that working together across diverse teams not only drives innovation but also builds a supportive environment where everyone's contributions are valued. Our commitment to continuous learning and development is central to our ethos; we invest in career development and mentorship opportunities to help our employees thrive and expand their skill sets. With a clear focus on personal and professional growth, we offer a dynamic career path that encourages ambition and rewards dedication, ensuring that each team member has the opportunity to reach their full potential and advance within the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the execution of architecture, development, implementation and quality practices in support of delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform
  • Implementation of cloud platform, operational and architectural patterns and practices to enable key features and drive new feature development
  • Participate in the selection of technology enablers to deliver performant, reliable and cost-optimized solutions
  • Design, build, and maintain cloud platform capabilities, aligned with DevOps and operational practices to rapidly and safely deploy new features to our platform
  • Collaborate with Product, Professional Services, and other stakeholders to develop new cloud-platform features and products
  • Create technical documentation for accessing, integrating, and using Parsable platform capabilities
  • Act as a senior technical team member in the delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform; gain and consistently maintain deep knowledge of our cloud platform and implementation technologies
  • Serve as a senior technical team member and subject matter expert within the platform engineering team and the larger engineering organization
  • Improve and build observability, uptime, and readiness metrics to detect problems and maintain our SLAs with our customers
  • Implement DevSecOps tooling, processes and procedures to promote rapid iteration and reliable delivery of new and updated features
  • Deliver quality work in an agile delivery model within a team environment
  • Share your work and data engineering best practices across the organization

Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years experience delivering customer-facing platforms at scale
  • 5+ years experience architecting, building and releasing production-grade within a SaaS environment
  • 5+ years experience developing backend services capabilities leveraging Go and/or Node (Typescript)
  • Demonstrated, hands-on mastery of the AWS suite of tools including Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, EventBridge, ECS, S3, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, and AuroraDB
  • Deep experience building product capabilities in a microservices architecture
  • Ability to assert and defend opinions on the merits of differing solutions
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Additional Requirements

  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience working in a global organization

Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications

Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how

CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.


In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

Come Join the CAI Team

At CAI, we pride ourselves on fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that working together across diverse teams not only drives innovation but also builds a supportive environment where everyone's contributions are valued. Our commitment to continuous learning and development is central to our ethos; we invest in career development and mentorship opportunities to help our employees thrive and expand their skill sets. With a clear focus on personal and professional growth, we offer a dynamic career path that encourages ambition and rewards dedication, ensuring that each team member has the opportunity to reach their full potential and advance within the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the execution of architecture, development, implementation and quality practices in support of delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform
  • Implementation of cloud platform, operational and architectural patterns and practices to enable key features and drive new feature development
  • Participate in the selection of technology enablers to deliver performant, reliable and cost-optimized solutions
  • Design, build, and maintain cloud platform capabilities, aligned with DevOps and operational practices to rapidly and safely deploy new features to our platform
  • Collaborate with Product, Professional Services, and other stakeholders to develop new cloud-platform features and products
  • Create technical documentation for accessing, integrating, and using Parsable platform capabilities
  • Act as a senior technical team member in the delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform; gain and consistently maintain deep knowledge of our cloud platform and implementation technologies
  • Serve as a senior technical team member and subject matter expert within the platform engineering team and the larger engineering organization
  • Improve and build observability, uptime, and readiness metrics to detect problems and maintain our SLAs with our customers
  • Implement DevSecOps tooling, processes and procedures to promote rapid iteration and reliable delivery of new and updated features
  • Deliver quality work in an agile delivery model within a team environment
  • Share your work and data engineering best practices across the organization

Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years experience delivering customer-facing platforms at scale
  • 5+ years experience architecting, building and releasing production-grade within a SaaS environment
  • 5+ years experience developing backend services capabilities leveraging Go and/or Node (Typescript)
  • Demonstrated, hands-on mastery of the AWS suite of tools including Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, EventBridge, ECS, S3, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, and AuroraDB
  • Deep experience building product capabilities in a microservices architecture
  • Ability to assert and defend opinions on the merits of differing solutions
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Additional Requirements

  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience working in a global organization

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

We are looking for SAP Basis Consultant who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Technical

Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications

Hands-on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP release version upgrades and infrastructure updates for cloud customers

Working experience with SAP HEC, SAP S/4HANA or any other cloud solution.

Hands-on experience with infrastructure operations, network, interfaces and Load Balancer topics related to SAP landscape management (TLO)

Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to form the solution/designing the mechanism for end to end solutioning

Hands on experience in Migration (onpremise to Cloud/Cross cloud/Cross DC's)

Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making

Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)

Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution

Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals

Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)


Good to have

Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how

Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals

Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4H Cloud

Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plus



What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
Title: Staff Platform Engineer

Business Unit: Process Manufacturing

Location: Brazil, remote

About CAI

CAI is a leading provider of digital work execution platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity in industrial environments. CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.


In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

Come Join the CAI Team

At CAI, we pride ourselves on fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that working together across diverse teams not only drives innovation but also builds a supportive environment where everyone's contributions are valued. Our commitment to continuous learning and development is central to our ethos; we invest in career development and mentorship opportunities to help our employees thrive and expand their skill sets. With a clear focus on personal and professional growth, we offer a dynamic career path that encourages ambition and rewards dedication, ensuring that each team member has the opportunity to reach their full potential and advance within the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the execution of architecture, development, implementation and quality practices in support of delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform
  • Implementation of cloud platform, operational and architectural patterns and practices to enable key features and drive new feature development
  • Participate in the selection of technology enablers to deliver performant, reliable and cost-optimized solutions
  • Design, build, and maintain cloud platform capabilities, aligned with DevOps and operational practices to rapidly and safely deploy new features to our platform
  • Collaborate with Product, Professional Services, and other stakeholders to develop new cloud-platform features and products
  • Create technical documentation for accessing, integrating, and using Parsable platform capabilities
  • Act as a senior technical team member in the delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform; gain and consistently maintain deep knowledge of our cloud platform and implementation technologies
  • Serve as a senior technical team member and subject matter expert within the platform engineering team and the larger engineering organization
  • Improve and build observability, uptime, and readiness metrics to detect problems and maintain our SLAs with our customers
  • Implement DevSecOps tooling, processes and procedures to promote rapid iteration and reliable delivery of new and updated features
  • Deliver quality work in an agile delivery model within a team environment
  • Share your work and data engineering best practices across the organization

Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years experience delivering customer-facing platforms at scale
  • 5+ years experience architecting, building and releasing production-grade within a SaaS environment
  • 5+ years experience developing backend services capabilities leveraging Go and/or Node (Typescript)
  • Demonstrated, hands-on mastery of the AWS suite of tools including Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, EventBridge, ECS, S3, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, and AuroraDB
  • Deep experience building product capabilities in a microservices architecture
  • Ability to assert and defend opinions on the merits of differing solutions
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Additional Requirements

  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience working in a global organization

Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
Title: Staff Platform Engineer

Business Unit: Process Manufacturing

Location: Brazil, remote

About CAI

CAI is a leading provider of digital work execution platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity in industrial environments. CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.


In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

Come Join the CAI Team

At CAI, we pride ourselves on fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that working together across diverse teams not only drives innovation but also builds a supportive environment where everyone's contributions are valued. Our commitment to continuous learning and development is central to our ethos; we invest in career development and mentorship opportunities to help our employees thrive and expand their skill sets. With a clear focus on personal and professional growth, we offer a dynamic career path that encourages ambition and rewards dedication, ensuring that each team member has the opportunity to reach their full potential and advance within the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the execution of architecture, development, implementation and quality practices in support of delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform
  • Implementation of cloud platform, operational and architectural patterns and practices to enable key features and drive new feature development
  • Participate in the selection of technology enablers to deliver performant, reliable and cost-optimized solutions
  • Design, build, and maintain cloud platform capabilities, aligned with DevOps and operational practices to rapidly and safely deploy new features to our platform
  • Collaborate with Product, Professional Services, and other stakeholders to develop new cloud-platform features and products
  • Create technical documentation for accessing, integrating, and using Parsable platform capabilities
  • Act as a senior technical team member in the delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform; gain and consistently maintain deep knowledge of our cloud platform and implementation technologies
  • Serve as a senior technical team member and subject matter expert within the platform engineering team and the larger engineering organization
  • Improve and build observability, uptime, and readiness metrics to detect problems and maintain our SLAs with our customers
  • Implement DevSecOps tooling, processes and procedures to promote rapid iteration and reliable delivery of new and updated features
  • Deliver quality work in an agile delivery model within a team environment
  • Share your work and data engineering best practices across the organization

Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years experience delivering customer-facing platforms at scale
  • 5+ years experience architecting, building and releasing production-grade within a SaaS environment
  • 5+ years experience developing backend services capabilities leveraging Go and/or Node (Typescript)
  • Demonstrated, hands-on mastery of the AWS suite of tools including Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, EventBridge, ECS, S3, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, and AuroraDB
  • Deep experience building product capabilities in a microservices architecture
  • Ability to assert and defend opinions on the merits of differing solutions
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Additional Requirements

  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience working in a global organization

title: Executivo(a) Comercial ERP
description:
Buscamos um(a) Executivo(a) Comercial para atuar de forma consultiva, fortalecendo clientes, resultados e parcerias de longo prazo. Se você é estratégico, próximo e movido por gerar valor e crescimento, vem construir sua carreira com a gente!


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Fazer o mapeamento do mercado de acordo com a área de atuação da unidade e nível de aderência do cliente à nossa plataforma de gestão.
  • Atuar como hunter , com foco em clientes de médio e grande porte nos segmentos de serviços, agronegócio, indústria, varejo, atacado e distribuição.
  • Atender leads gerados pela área de outbound e atuar com prospecção de novos clientes, alinhado à estratégia de negócios e às metas da unidade.
  • Alimentar o CRM conforme a evolução de sua atuação, garantindo a gestão de pipeline e forecasts no sistema.
  • Realizar apresentações da solução com ênfase nas necessidades do prospect, transmitindo o diferencial do software Sankhya.
  • Conduzir negociações sustentando relações rentáveis e positivas para a empresa e para os clientes.
  • Elaborar propostas no sistema e fazer follow-up até o fechamento.
  • Participar de eventos de mercado para identificar tendências, fortalecer networking e gerar novas oportunidades de negócio.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a DevOps Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teams


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
  • Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
  • Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.



Essential Skills

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;
  • Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
  • Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch;
  • Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

description:
Business Analyst (Financial)


**Add resumes in English**


• Ensure JDE, Trintech, and other financial applications are compliant with Gallagher’s IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.

• Evaluate SOC reports to ensure vendor and application compliance and surface risks.

Skills

Required:

• Relevant experience working with Financial ERP applications, preferably JDE

• Design and Development Experience with JDE

• Experience working with third party vendors to implement SaaS solutions

• Working "hands-on" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies

• Financial acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of key accounting, financial management and analysis processes, including but not limited to General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, revenue recognition, budgeting, and bank interfaces

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel and Project

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering or related field

• Relevant experience with technology project support

• Experience with one or for of the following applications: JDE, Trintech Cadency, Workiva, Cognos Analytics, Analytics, OneStream, and Varicent

• Understanding of Single Sign-On and Identity Management solutions

• Advanced level proficiency with Microsoft Office tools including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio

• Intermediate SQL query skills

• Experience working in large enterprises with domestic and international locations

• Experience working with off-shore or remote development/support teams

As a DevOps Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teams


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
  • Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
  • Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.



Essential Skills

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;
  • Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;

  • Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;

title: JD Edwards (Financial Consultant)
description:
Business Analyst (Financial)


**Add resumes in English**


• Ensure JDE, Trintech, and other financial applications are compliant with Gallagher’s IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.

• Evaluate SOC reports to ensure vendor and application compliance and surface risks.

Skills

Required:

• Relevant experience working with Financial ERP applications, preferably JDE

• Design and Development Experience with JDE

• Experience working with third party vendors to implement SaaS solutions

• Working "hands-on" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies

• Financial acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of key accounting, financial management and analysis processes, including but not limited to General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, revenue recognition, budgeting, and bank interfaces

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel and Project


Requirements:


• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering or related field

• Relevant experience with technology project support

• Experience with one or for of the following applications: JDE, Trintech Cadency, Workiva, Cognos Analytics, Analytics, OneStream, and Varicent

• Understanding of Single Sign-On and Identity Management solutions

• Advanced level proficiency with Microsoft Office tools including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio

• Intermediate SQL query skills

• Experience working in large enterprises with domestic and international locations

• Experience working with off-shore or remote development/support teams

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 54563


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 6 anos atuando JAVA, com versões atuais, Springboot e Quarkus;

- Experiência em AWS ( Lambda, S3, CloudFormation, EC2, SQS e RDS);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de APIs e automações;

- Atuar profissionalmente com JavaScript e Angular 2+ para aplicações web;

- OCR para extração e leitura de informações em imagens e documentos.

- Docker para padronização e conteinerização de ambiente;

- Experiência em Grafana para monitoramento e análise de métricas;

- Experiência com Langfuse e LangChain para integração e desenvolvimento de soluções com IA generativa;

- Fundamentos de IA, Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Linguagem Natural;

- Fundamentos de Engenharia de Dados (ETL, modelagem e transformação);

- Experiência com RAG.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Engenheiro Eletricista
description:
Vaga: Engenheiro Eletricista – com conhecimento em EPLAN


Sobre a oportunidade:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) Elétrico(a) com experiência em projetos industriais e domínio do software EPLAN, para atuar no desenvolvimento de esquemas elétricos, painéis e documentações técnicas. Buscamos um perfil analítico, detalhista e comprometido com qualidade e prazos.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar e revisar projetos elétricos utilizando o EPLAN;
  • Desenvolver diagramas elétricos e listas de materiais de painéis e máquinas industriais;
  • Apoiar o time de automação e montagem elétrica em especificações técnicas;
  • Garantir conformidade com normas e padrões elétricos aplicáveis;
  • Participar de melhorias de processo e padronização de documentação técnica.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos elétricos industriais;
  • Domínio do software EPLAN;
  • Conhecimento em normas técnicas e dimensionamento de componentes;
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e boa comunicação.


Diferenciais:

  • Vivência em automação industrial e integração de sistemas;
  • Conhecimento em CLP e redes industriais;
  • Conhecimento em pneumática;
  • Conhecimento em sensores industriais;
  • Conhecimento no EPLAN Pro Panel;
  • Inglês técnico.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Handling major incidents via CIRS (Critical Issue Response System) and providing frequent updates until resolution.
  • Performing deep-dive application troubleshooting and identifying preventive actions.
  • Managing CIRS-related requests including deployments, feature toggles, and data fixes.
  • Following up on major production incidents and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
  • Enhancing monitoring capabilities using tools like Dynatrace, Kibana, and Splunk .
  • Writing and improving monitoring scripts and alerts based on incident learnings.
  • Handling customer escalations and coordinating with Support & Engineering teams.
  • Supporting planned activities and responding to ad-hoc requests from CES teams.


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Deep experience in DevOps and Production Support .
  • Experience in automation and CI/CD practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Kibana, Splunk .
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to deep dive into application issues.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills across teams.


Please submit resumé in English.

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.

title: PESSOA COORDENADORA DE PLANEJAMENTO DAS OPERAÇÕES
description:
A Saber faz parte do Grupo Cogna Educação, uma das principais organizações educacionais do mundo. Nossas soluções abrangem o ambiente virtual completo de aprendizagem, tutoria especializada, material pedagógico, amplo portfólio de cursos, atendimento ao estudante, BackOffice de pagamento e monitoramento da jornada de alunos.


Nesta vaga você irá atuar no Programa Nacional de Livros Didáticos (PNLD ) com as editoras Ática e Scipione , com a oferta de livros didáticos para mais de 118 mil escolas públicas em todo o país. É uma super oportunidade de mudar a educação no Brasil para melhor! #AquiéCogna

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Elaborar e gerenciar o planejamento operacional da empresa;
  • Realizar análise de dados;
  • Desenvolver estratégias de produção e planejamento logístico;
  • Gerenciar equipe e promover a gestão de pessoas;
  • Apresentar relatórios e análises para executivos;
  • Garantir a eficiência e qualidade das operações - níveis de estoque, SLA de entrega, níveis de ruptura;
  • Responsável pelo processo de S&OP, GATE, GORD.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência comprovada em planejamento estratégico e operacional;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI.


Diferencial:

  • Planejamento Logístico e Supply Chain.


Perfil comportamental:

  • Habilidade em comunicação efetiva e trabalho em equipe.
  • Proatividade, adaptabilidade e resiliência.


Informações adicionais

Modelo de trabalho híbrido sendo 2x presencial em nosso escritório na Av. Paulista e 3x home office.


O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.



Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Handling major incidents via CIRS (Critical Issue Response System) and providing frequent updates until resolution.
  • Performing deep-dive application troubleshooting and identifying preventive actions.
  • Managing CIRS-related requests including deployments, feature toggles, and data fixes.
  • Following up on major production incidents and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
  • Enhancing monitoring capabilities using tools like Dynatrace, Kibana, and Splunk .
  • Writing and improving monitoring scripts and alerts based on incident learnings.
  • Handling customer escalations and coordinating with Support & Engineering teams.
  • Supporting planned activities and responding to ad-hoc requests from CES teams.


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Deep experience in DevOps and Production Support .
  • Experience in automation and CI/CD practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Kibana, Splunk .
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to deep dive into application issues.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills across teams.

title: APRENDIZ
description:
O Iveco Group está com vagas abertas para Jovem Aprendiz!

Se você está em busca do primeiro passo na sua trajetória profissional, gosta de aprender, tem curiosidade e vontade de crescer, essa é a sua chance de fazer parte de uma empresa global, inovadora e comprometida com o desenvolvimento de pessoas.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Idade de 18 a 22 anos;
  • Para o sexo masculino é obrigatória a dispensa do serviço militar;


Benefícios:

  • Formação SENAI;
  • Remuneração R$ 1.512,00;
  • Alimentação na empresa;
  • Vale transporte + fretado.


Prazo de inscrição: até 14/11.


Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Nós 'trabalhamos com forças diversas', pois acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas nos fazem crescer como organização, nos desafiam a evoluir continuamente e contribuem para a construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável. Por isso, convidamos pessoas de todos os gêneros, raças, idades, orientações sexuais e capacidades físicas a se candidatarem e fazerem parte do nosso time.


Vem com a gente nessa estrada!

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Handling major incidents via CIRS (Critical Issue Response System) and providing frequent updates until resolution.
  • Performing deep-dive application troubleshooting and identifying preventive actions.
  • Managing CIRS-related requests including deployments, feature toggles, and data fixes.
  • Following up on major production incidents and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
  • Enhancing monitoring capabilities using tools like Dynatrace, Kibana, and Splunk .

  • Handling customer escalations and coordinating with Support & Engineering teams.

  • Deep experience in DevOps and Production Support .
  • Experience in automation and CI/CD practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Kibana, Splunk .
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to deep dive into application issues.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills across teams.

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP MM/DRC- S/4HANA,Remote mode who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Must Have

Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, NFe knowledge and enhancements to supply processes specially with SAP DRC, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects. Experience with SAP DRC inbound.


Good to Have

Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC outbound.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requitements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Lead the end-to-end implementation of SAP DRC NF-e projects, including requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.

Customize and optimize SAP DRC solutions to ensure seamless electronic invoicing (NF-e) compliance in Brazil or other supported jurisdictions.

Ensure accurate integration of SAP DRC with external systems, including government tax portals and legacy systems.

Provide subject matter expertise on local tax regulations and compliance requirements for e-invoicing.

Identify risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies during the project lifecycle.

Conduct user training, support issue resolution, and provide go-live assistance.

Maintain documentation for processes, configurations, and project changes.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Experience in a Professional Consumers and package (CPG) company is an asset.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for "SAP ABAP" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAdI, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4HANA Private Cloud, S/4HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement

Setup and configure necessary S/4HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.

Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.

Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

We are looking for "SAP ABAP" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAdI, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4HANA Private Cloud, S/4HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement

Setup and configure necessary S/4HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.

Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.

Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

title: Team Lead (Coordenação de Pessoas)
description:
Responsável pela visão do produto com base na estratégia da TOTVS, gerenciando o desenvolvimento de conteúdo de produto e priorizando o desenvolvimento do software (roadmap). Visando garantir a evolução e rentabilidade do portfólio de produto.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Promover o desenvolvimento da equipe em hard skill e soft skill considerando o plano de carreira desejado, participando das cerimônias ágeis do time e colegiados de avaliação de performance.
  • Criar e manter um time de alta performance, por meio do levantamento do perfil necessário e seleção adequada de candidatos.
  • Desdobrar as metas da companhia e do segmento/plataforma para o dev team para o atingimento dos resultados estratégicos, a partir dos insumos obtidos do Product Manager e Agile Coach.
  • Desenvolvimento do onboarding do novo funcionário e realização de ações de motivação e engajamento. Análise de elegíveis para ações salariais e ações de reconhecimento (treinamentos e programas de valorização).
  • Garantir o cumprimento da legislação, por meio de acompanhamento das horas extras, férias, rescisões, banco de horas, aposentadoria, entre outros itens relacionados a legislação trabalhista brasileira.
  • Assegurar a entrega das metas dos times para o atingimento dos objetivos da estratégia da TOTVS, a partir do desdobramento da estratégia corporativa, alinhamento e acompanhamento da evolução das entregas do time.
  • Disseminar a cultura TOTVS e Ágil, sendo um exemplo dos valores éticos. Influenciando o mindset colaborativo, por meio das interações nas cerimônias ágeis.
  • Participar da tomada de decisão relacionada à estratégia de gestão de pessoas junto ao Tribe Lead (responsável pelo segmento/plataforma) por meio de aconselhamento/insumos, levando em consideração a experiência do Team Lead.
  • Capacitar e desenvolver sucessores de suas squads, de modo que seja possível contratar e reter talentos para o time, a partir da aplicação de feedbacks constantes e ações on the job.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Formação Acadêmica Desejável:
  • Pós Graduação / MBA

Área de Formação Acadêmica Desejável

  • Superior completo e desejável pós graduação em Gestão.
  • Management 3.0
  • Métodos Ágeis
  • Gestão orçamentária, OKRs, SLA, ROI e NPS Certificação:
  • Produtos SaaS
  • Coach - desejável Idiomas:
  • Inglês ou Espanhol – desejável nível avançado

Requisitos desejáveis


SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:

  • Negócio de Recursos Humanos

title: Assistente de coleta de dados
description:
Sobre a vaga


Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional organizado(a), analítico(a), responsável por coletar, organizar e registrar informações relevantes em diferentes contextos, garantindo a qualidade e precisão dos dados coletados.


Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar a coleta de dados remotamente, conforme orientações e padrões internos.
  • Garantir a precisão e a integridade dos dados registrados.
  • Seguir protocolos e metodologias estabelecidas para a coleta de informações.
  • Trabalhar com ferramentas e dispositivos específicos para registro de dados (sistema interno e/ou tabelas).
  • Manter comunicação clara e regular com a equipe para reportar status e possíveis dificuldades na coleta.
  • Cumprir prazos e metas de coleta estabelecidas.


Requisitos:

  • Facilidade em lidar com tecnologias e ferramentas digitais.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e habilidade para trabalhar com precisão.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de interação com equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas do Pacote Office , especialmente Excel .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com coleta de dados em pesquisas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de geoprocessamento, como ArcGIS ou QGIS.
  • Conhecimento básico em indicadores e métricas de qualidade de dados.

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional organizado(a), analítico(a), responsável por coletar, organizar e registrar informações relevantes em diferentes contextos, garantindo a qualidade e precisão dos dados coletados.


Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar a coleta de dados remotamente, conforme orientações e padrões internos.
  • Garantir a precisão e a integridade dos dados registrados.
  • Seguir protocolos e metodologias estabelecidas para a coleta de informações.
  • Trabalhar com ferramentas e dispositivos específicos para registro de dados (sistema interno e/ou tabelas).
  • Manter comunicação clara e regular com a equipe para reportar status e possíveis dificuldades na coleta.
  • Cumprir prazos e metas de coleta estabelecidas.


Requisitos:

  • Facilidade em lidar com tecnologias e ferramentas digitais.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e habilidade para trabalhar com precisão.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de interação com equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas do Pacote Office , especialmente Excel .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com coleta de dados em pesquisas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de geoprocessamento, como ArcGIS ou QGIS.
  • Conhecimento básico em indicadores e métricas de qualidade de dados.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de Gerente de Engenharia de Software para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas brasileiros. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidade e atribuições:

  • Junto com o CPTO e outro Engineering Manager, contribuir na visão estratégica da área de Engenharia, conciliando com as demandas táticas;
  • Liderar as frentes de Pagamentos e Plataforma;
  • Fazer a gestão das pessoas do time;
  • Ajudar na gestão dos projetos, em demandas de prazos, métricas, etc;
  • Assumir um papel de promotor da cultura da Jusfy;
  • Ser um facilitador e um apoio nas decisões técnicas de Engenharia;
  • Colaborar com a agilidade das entregas e dos times;
  • Ter um papel crítico e analítico do time;
  • Auxiliar na resolução dos problemas da área;
  • Fazendo interface com a área de Produto.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência como gerente de times de engenharia de software em fintechs ou times de pagamentos;
  • Possuir uma visão estratégica da área;
  • Vivência em gestão de projetos;
  • Ter uma boa visão ágil, experiência com MVP;
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas;
  • Background técnico em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Ser crítico e analítico;
  • Boa capacidade de resolução de problemas;
  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia.


Diferenciais:

  • Vivências em empresas SaaS;
  • Conhecimentos ou experiência em softwares jurídicos;
  • Experiência com PLG.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Gerente de Engenharia e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se inscreva pelo LinkedIn.

title: Squad Leader/Scrum Master
description:
Vaga: Scrum Master / Agile Lead


Sobre o Projeto:

O(a) profissional atuará em um projeto de modernização de sistema legado , com foco em coordenar times ágeis durante a migração e reengenharia de sistemas.

A posição exige liderança, organização e visão estratégica para garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas aos objetivos técnicos e de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar squads multidisciplinares durante as fases de modernização e migração do sistema legado.
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva), promovendo engajamento e colaboração entre os times.
  • Monitorar métricas de produtividade, qualidade e entrega , garantindo a transparência e previsibilidade do projeto.
  • Apoiar o Product Owner na gestão do backlog, priorização e remoção de impedimentos.
  • Garantir alinhamento técnico entre as equipes e os Tech Leads/Arquitetos , assegurando coerência entre planejamento e execução.
  • Atuar como agente de melhoria contínua , promovendo boas práticas de agilidade e cultura colaborativa.


Requisitos Técnicos e Experiências:

  • Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master, Agile Coach ou Líder Técnico em ambientes ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão ágil , como Jira, Confluence e similares.
  • Habilidade em liderança, facilitação e resolução de conflitos .
  • Vivência com projetos de modernização ou reengenharia de sistemas , preferencialmente com uso de Strangler Pattern .
  • Desejável experiência como Gerente de Projetos , com conhecimento em metodologias tradicionais (PMBOK) .


Desejável:

  • Certificações em Scrum Master (PSM, CSM) ou Gerenciamento de Projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP) .
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos , que combinem práticas ágeis e tradicionais.
  • Capacidade de conduzir transições culturais e técnicas em equipes de diferentes níveis de maturidade ágil.


Venha se conectar conosco!

Responsabilidades:

  • Monitorar métricas de produtividade, qualidade e entrega , garantindo a transparência e previsibilidade do projeto.
  • Apoiar o Product Owner na gestão do backlog, priorização e remoção de impedimentos.

title: Squad Leader/Scrum Master
description:
Vaga: Scrum Master / Agile Lead


Sobre o Projeto:

O(a) profissional atuará em um projeto de modernização de sistema legado , com foco em coordenar times ágeis durante a migração e reengenharia de sistemas.

A posição exige liderança, organização e visão estratégica para garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas aos objetivos técnicos e de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar squads multidisciplinares durante as fases de modernização e migração do sistema legado.
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva), promovendo engajamento e colaboração entre os times.
  • Monitorar métricas de produtividade, qualidade e entrega , garantindo a transparência e previsibilidade do projeto.
  • Apoiar o Product Owner na gestão do backlog, priorização e remoção de impedimentos.
  • Garantir alinhamento técnico entre as equipes e os Tech Leads/Arquitetos , assegurando coerência entre planejamento e execução.
  • Atuar como agente de melhoria contínua , promovendo boas práticas de agilidade e cultura colaborativa.


Requisitos Técnicos e Experiências:

  • Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master, Agile Coach ou Líder Técnico em ambientes ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão ágil , como Jira, Confluence e similares.
  • Habilidade em liderança, facilitação e resolução de conflitos .
  • Vivência com projetos de modernização ou reengenharia de sistemas , preferencialmente com uso de Strangler Pattern .
  • Desejável experiência como Gerente de Projetos , com conhecimento em metodologias tradicionais (PMBOK) .


Desejável:

  • Certificações em Scrum Master (PSM, CSM) ou Gerenciamento de Projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP) .
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos , que combinem práticas ágeis e tradicionais.
  • Capacidade de conduzir transições culturais e técnicas em equipes de diferentes níveis de maturidade ágil.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior
description:
A Listenx é líder  em Music Branding  na América latina.


Atuamos no modelo SAAS  combinando tecnologia, música e anúncios  no ponto de vendas para entregar comunicação estratégica e experiências musicais que fidelizam clientes e aumentam vendas.


Com soluções para todos os tamanhos de empresas, a Listenx está presente em mais de 16.000  clientes de todos os tamanhos no Brasil e América latina.


Somos apaixonados por música, tecnologia e inovação , crescemos em ritmo acelerado e estamos buscando pessoas para construir essa jornada junto com a gente.


✔️Sua missão:

Você terá a missão de projetar, desenvolver e evoluir aplicações web em front-end e back-end, garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e a melhor experiência para o usuário. Atuará como referência técnica, apoiando o crescimento de desenvolvedores do time e contribuindo para a inovação dos nossos produtos.


✔️É imprescindível que você conheça:


Linguagens e tecnologias

  • PHP (5, 7, 8)
  • C#
  • Node.Js
  • .NET (4.5 ou superior)
  • JavaScript (ES6+)
  • TypeScript
  • HTML 5
  • CSS


Banco de dados

  • MySQL
  • Doctrine (ORM)
  • PostgreSQL


Front-End

  • jQuery
  • AngularJS
  • React
  • Bootstrap
  • HTML 5
  • CSS
  • JavaScrip
  • TypeScript
  • ES6


Frameworks e Bibliotecas

  • NET (4.5 ou superior)
  • AngularJS
  • Bootstrap
  • Framework PHP MVC (ex: Yii)
  • Doctrine (ORM)
  • React
  • Wordpress


Servidores

  • Apache
  • NGINX
  • Docker


Metodologias

  • Scrum (ágeis)
  • Kanban (ágeis)
  • TDD


Controle de versão


  • Git e SVN


✔️Conhecimentos desejáveis:

  • Servidores Linux, React Native, NET CORE, Mensageria (SQS, RabbitMQ), Wordpress e Docker.


✔️Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Desenvolvimento de App's para TV (LG, Samsung, etc)
  • Tecnologias com I.A., Python, AWS (EC2, RDS, Cloudfront), testes unitários e processos assíncronos.


✔️O que esperamos de você:

  • Qualidade nas entregas: garantir entregas eficientes, com atenção a detalhes e poucas correções.
  • Foco na entrega: respeitar prazos, cumprir combinados e objetivos definidos.
  • Organização: planejar tarefas, manter clareza nas etapas e facilitar acompanhamento.
  • Análise crítica: avaliar processos e resultados, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e possíveis riscos para evolução.


✔️Requisitos e diferenciais:

  • Acima de 5 anos de experiência: Desenvolvimento de software para web e aplicações desktop (Nível Sênior).
  • Superior concluído: Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia da Computação e afins.
  • Cursos Desejáveis : Cursos de lógica de programação, JavaScript, e afins.

title: Programa Potenciais 2026 - Jaguariúna
description:
Descrição da vaga

Iniciar a jornada profissional é um dos capítulos mais emocionantes da vida universitária! E na Stefanini, estamos prontos para transformar esse primeiro passo em uma experiência inesquecível! Apresentamos o Programa Potenciais 2026 , que chegou com toda a energia!


Se você está mergulhado nos estudos e deseja lançar sua carreira com o pé direito, junte-se a nós! Este programa é feito sob medida para você!


Esta é a sua oportunidade de embarcar em uma das maiores empresas de tecnologia do mundo, onde você poderá absorver conhecimento e se destacar como um verdadeiro diferencial no competitivo mercado de trabalho.


Prepare-se para essa aventura e venha conosco!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que vou aprender?

Como estagiário do Programa Potenciais 2026 você irá aprender como funciona o nosso Ciclo Comercial . No período de 1 ano , você terá a oportunidade de vivenciar experiências como:


Comercial

Nessa área você poderá:

  • Apoiar na prospecção e qualificação de leads. Sua principal função não será vender, mas encontrar as oportunidades com alto potencial de fechamento para serem enviadas aos vendedores;
  • Apoiar em licitações e novos contratos de clientes estratégicos, e muito mais;


Pré-vendas

Em que você poderá:

  • Colaborar na elaboração de propostas técnicas, gerar prices e participar de reuniões internas com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar um projeto exclusivo para o Programa Potenciais, que envolve tecnologia aplicada à área de Pré-Vendas.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial para analisar dados, identificar oportunidades e apoiar em projetos internos.


Nesse processo você contará com um time altamente qualificado de gerentes e diretores para capacitá-lo durante sua jornada.

Nosso time de Gente & Cultura estará a postos para desenvolver habilidades e garantir o melhor aproveitamento do programa!

Além de diversos treinamentos e ferramentas que farão com que você se torne protagonista da sua carreira!




Requisitos e qualificações

Quais são os requisitos?


✅ Estar cursando ensino superior;

✅ Ter disponível pelo menos 1 ano e 6 meses para estagiar (se formar a partir de junho/2027);

✅ Ter disponibilidade de estagiar 6 horas por dia em horário comercial;

✅ Ter interesse de atuar nas áreas destacadas no programa (Comercial e pré-vendas), afinal este é o foco do Programa Potenciais;

✅ Ser curioso e ter vontade de aprender todos os dias;

✅ Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente de 3 a 4 vezes por semana em um dos nosso escritórios em Jaguariúna-SP;


⛔ Todos os requisitos são obrigatórios! Preencha seu formulário de inscrição com muita atenção, ok!

❗ Inglês avançado é um diferencial, temos clientes globais!

⚠️ Não nos apegamos a curso ou instituição! O que nós queremos saber é se você topa esse desafio com a gente.



Informações adicionais

O que oferecemos?

Bolsa Auxílio - compatível com o mercado

Vale Alimentação ou Refeição - opções aceitas em todo o país!

Mentoring - Uma plataforma de mentorias com diversos profissionais de diversas áreas para você tirar o máximo conhecimento sobre tecnologia e inovação!

Academia Stefanini - Uma plataforma repleta de conteúdo, cursos e treinamentos.

️Assistência psicológica.

E muito mais!
